svg.text: Redrawn from Fender 'Princeton Reverb-Amp AA1164' drawing no. D 045427 rev A, sheet 2 of 2 (layout) — not a trace
Note: the heater wiring always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
green — output and reverb transformer leads (lettered GREEN on the sheet; not a heater)
green — 6.3 V heaters (floating pair; the green-yellow centre tap grounded at the chassis)
